title: Record whether a run went through the pipeline or was closed by hand (execution_mode on runs.jsonl), and split the retro on it
summary: Added optional execution_mode (pipeline/hand) to runs.jsonl: record_hand_orchestrated_closure.py writes hand, all 8 real pipeline record_run.py call sites across 4 workflow .js files write pipeline; generate_retro.py Run Summary now splits pipeline/hand/unlabelled instead of blending them.
